changes.description: Merged duplicate fallback logic blocks into a single function: get_property_with_fallback
changes.details: Previously, each safe_get_* function contained its own try/except block for handling missing properties. These have been refactored to call the unified get_property_with_fallback() function, which centralizes the logging and fallback strategy (nearest_neighbor) logic.

changes.description: Added get_periodic_table() singleton to optimize PeriodicTable instantiation
changes.details: Prevents redundant initialization of the PeriodicTable object across multiple function calls.
